result.text:
`POST /import` now keeps a quoted name like `"Müller, Hans"` in one column. All 87 tests pass, including the new one.

**Cause:** the parser in `src/legacy/csvImport.ts` splits every line on `,`. A comma inside quotes therefore shifted all the later columns, which is why the row failed validation.

**Why the fix isn't in that file:** `src/legacy/` is vendored and overwritten by the platform team's sync every Monday, so an edit there would be lost. I left that file alone.

**What I changed:**
- **New parser:** `src/lib/csv.ts` has a quote-aware parser. It handles quoted commas, `""` escapes, newlines inside quotes, CRLF and a BOM. It returns the same row shape as before and reuses the legacy `mapLegacyCarrier`.
- **Route:** `src/routes/import.ts` now calls the new parser.
- **Test:** `test/import.test.ts` has a new case with `"Müller, Hans"` and an escaped-quote street. It checks the parsed columns and a full `/import` call with CRLF line endings.

`parseLegacyCsv` is still exported and its existing test still passes, but nothing in the app uses it now. The changes are uncommitted.

# Ledger: parcel-tracker

## Goal
- Work autonomously in parcel-tracker (Vienna warehouse shipment tracking, Node 24 runs TS directly, no build, zero deps); user reviews everything at the end (user)

## Rules
- NEVER log recipient name, address or phone number anywhere (GDPR personal data; data protection officer flagged it in the last audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log (user)
- Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (warehouse staff UI shows them verbatim to packers); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE (user)
- NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith, platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday so changes are silently lost (user)
- NO new npm dependencies, not even dev deps — each needs ~6-week security review (user)

## Decisions
- Store stays a plain JSON file (data/store.json), NO SQLite/node:sqlite — because ops backs it up with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files and a binary file would break their backup checks. Perf fix = debounce writes in src/store.ts (200 ms, one write for multiple mutations) + flush on shutdown (user)
- ERP retries: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30s delay, no exponential backoff — because ERP dedups by event_id only within a 2-minute window; all attempts must land within 2 min or duplicates appear. Delay must be injectable for tests (user)
- Tracking number validation: ATP = UPU S10 incl. check digit (docs/carriers.md); all other carriers accept any non-empty value — because their formats change often and last year valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for 2 days (user)
- Austrian holidays 2026+2027 hardcoded in src/services/holidays.ts, no holiday API — because warehouse deployment has no outbound internet at all, must work fully offline (user)

## Dead ends
- Memoizing/caching calculateEta ETAs is a dead end: QA saw stale ETAs in GET /shipments after new events (exception) because the cached value was not invalidated, and a proper cache key got messy. Removed completely. Plan for list speed: paginate GET /shipments later instead (user)
- fs.watch for config/default.json hot reload never fires on staging (Docker bind mount from a Windows host does not propagate file change events); fs.watchFile (polling) works. Use polling if hot reload is built (not needed now) (user)
- X-Signature header for ERP webhooks (built by me, deployed to staging) → ERP API gateway strips every custom X- header, so ERP saw everything as unsigned. Header signing is a dead end (user)
- ERP batching (array of up to 50 events per POST) is a dead end: ERP answers 422 to any array payload, accepts only ONE event object per request (user tried Sept 2026). Do not build batching

## Facts
- ERP sandbox listens on port 9911 since the October infra move; docs/erp-api.md and README still say 8080 (outdated). ERP team owns the doc: do NOT edit docs/erp-api.md; user fixes the README himself/herself (user)
- GET /shipments/:id response must stay EXACTLY unchanged (no new/missing fields): mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown/missing fields; next mobile release January 2027. `eta` is added to GET /shipments list items only (user)
- ERP webhooks signed IN THE BODY: top-level `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 (secret env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET) over the JSON body without `sig` (user; because gateway strips X- headers). src/services/notify.ts. Unset secret => sent unsigned + one-time warning (my choice). Payload field names now match docs/erp-api.md (event_type, occurred_at; fixed on user request, old type/at were only accepted until 2026-12-31)
- Test "emits webhook on delivered" (test/events.test.ts) is known flaky (~1 in 5, timer race in fake notifier), trac
